lines.zh: 缓慢蠕动，发出低沉嘶嘶声
lines.en: Slowly slither, make a low hiss

lines.zh: 皮肤干瘪，肉眼可见皱纹
lines.en: Skin shriveled, wrinkles visible

lines.zh: 紧贴地面爬行，寻找食物
lines.en: Crawl close to ground, seek food

lines.zh: 触手一般的手臂伸向玩家
lines.en: Arms like tentacles reach for the player

lines.zh: 饥饿难耐，不断蠕动向前
lines.en: Starving, constantly slither forward

lines.zh: 目光呆滞，盯着玩家不放
lines.en: Stare blankly at the player
Spot food, quickly crawl over
Encounter obstacle, slowly sidestep
Hear footsteps, stop slithering
Find a companion, slowly approach

lines.zh: 我拖着两条断腿往前爬。
lines.en: I drag two broken legs forward.
My nails scrape along the stone.
Lie quietly in a dark corner

lines.zh: 我的皮贴在肋骨上，一皱一皱
lines.en: My skin clings to my ribs, creased and twitching.

lines.zh: 目光呆滞，盯着空无一物
lines.en: Stare blankly at nothing
Slowly slither, seek food

lines.zh: 紧贴地面爬行，寻找猎物
lines.en: Crawl close to ground, seek prey
Smelling meat, I suddenly speed up.
Occasionally move, stay active

lines.zh: 我伏在暗处，等脚步再近
lines.en: I lie in the dark, waiting for steps to come nearer.

lines.zh: 偶尔伸展手臂，保持灵活
lines.en: Occasionally stretch arms, stay flexible
Find a companion, slowly approach
Blank stare at the player
Reach out arms, seek the player

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，皮肉一褶一褶
lines.en: I lift my face, the skin folding in creases.
Slither slowly, approach the player

lines.zh: 发出低沉嘶嘶声，寻找玩家
lines.en: Make a low hiss, seek the player

lines.zh: 我眼珠不动，只跟着你的影
lines.en: My eyeballs never move, only follow your shadow.

lines.zh: 手臂触手一般伸向玩家
lines.en: Arms like tentacles reach for the player
Spot the player, quickly crawl over
I stop and tilt my head toward the sound.
Approach slowly, seek the player
One of my tendrils snapped.

lines.zh: 爬着走，伤口一路蹭在地上。
lines.en: I drag along, my wound scraping the ground.
My body is hurt!
My tentacles are hurt!
Tendrils injured!
I'm hurt, heal me!

lines.zh: 我爬过的地上，留了一道血痕。
lines.en: A smear of blood follows where I crawl.
My body's hurt!
I'm hurt, please!
One of my nails snapped!

lines.zh: 蠕动着接近你，寒气直逼喉管。
lines.en: Creeping closer, chill reaching your throat.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的冰冷触感了吗？
lines.en: Can you feel its cold touch?

lines.zh: 它那腐烂的腹部，散发着恶臭。
lines.en: Its rotting belly stinks to the skies.

lines.zh: 它的触手紧紧缠绕，你窒息了。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap tight, choking you.

lines.zh: 你的火焰被它的寒意熄灭。
lines.en: Your fire is doused by its chill.

lines.zh: 你被它的粘液粘住，动弹不得。
lines.en: You're stuck by its slime, unable to move.

lines.zh: 它慢慢靠近，渴望着你的生命。
lines.en: It slowly approaches, yearning for your life.

lines.zh: 它的存在让周围的空气变得冰冷。
lines.en: Its presence turns the air around you cold.

lines.zh: 你感到它那腐烂的牙齿逼近你的喉咙。
lines.en: You feel its rotten teeth near your throat.

lines.zh: 它的目光中满是对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Its gaze is filled with desire for prey.
Tentacles wrap around, colliding with it.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，触手缠绕你。
lines.en: You collide with it, tentacles wrapping around you.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住你，你无法挣脱。
lines.en: Its tentacles entangle you, restraining you.
Tentacles wrap, tugging you around.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，被其粘液黏住。
lines.en: You collide with it, stuck by its slime.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住你，让你无法动弹。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, immobilizing you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，触手缠绕你的四肢。
lines.en: You collide with it, tentacles wrapping your limbs.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，触手缠绕你的身体。
lines.en: You collide with it, tentacles wrapping your body.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你，你被拉扯到它的位置。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, pulling you to its position.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，触手缠绕你的脖子。
lines.en: You collide with it, tentacles wrapping your neck.

lines.zh: 它寻找着同类，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, a partner.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的叫声，四处游荡。
lines.en: It calls out for a mate, wandering aimlessly.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕在一起，互相寻找。
lines.en: Its tentacles entwine, seeking each other.

lines.zh: 它们相遇，触手缠绕在一起。
lines.en: They meet, tentacles entwining.

lines.zh: 它靠近同类，开始求偶仪式。
lines.en: It approaches a fellow crawler, starting the mating ritual.

lines.zh: 它的触手紧紧缠绕，求偶成功。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap tightly, the mating successful.

lines.zh: 它们互相触碰，开始求偶。
lines.en: They touch each other, beginning the mating process.

lines.zh: 求偶成功，它们开始求偶舞蹈。
lines.en: Mating successful, they begin the mating dance.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声回荡在地下世界。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes through the underworld.

lines.zh: 它与同类交缠，开始求偶。
lines.en: It entwines with a fellow crawler, beginning the mating process.

lines.zh: 蠕动着接近腐朽的尸骸
lines.en: Creeping closer to the rotting remains

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉紧绷着，发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Rotten muscles tense, producing a hiss

lines.zh: 缓慢地向前爬行，寻找腐肉
lines.en: Slowly crawling forward, searching for carrion

lines.zh: 啃噬着腐朽的骨头，发出咯吱声
lines.en: Chomping on rotted bones, producing creaking sounds

lines.zh: 啃食着腐烂的皮肉，发出嘎吱声
lines.en: Chomping on rotten flesh, producing a crunching sound

lines.zh: 爬向腐烂的肉块，发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Crawling towards the rotting meat chunk, producing a hiss

lines.zh: 啃咬着腐烂的内脏，发出咕噜声
lines.en: Chomping on rotten organs, producing a gurgle

lines.zh: 啃食腐烂的骨头，发出咔嚓声
lines.en: Chomping on rotted bones, producing a crunch

lines.zh: 啃咬腐烂的尸块，发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Chomping on rotting flesh chunks, producing a hiss

lines.zh: 啃噬腐朽的肌肉，发出咯吱声
lines.en: Chomping on rotted muscle, producing a creak
Acquiring prey's location
Target acquired, initiating pursuit
Nose to the ground, I catch the scent.
Tracking prey's scent
Targeting prey's trail
Acquiring prey's position
Initiating prey pursuit
My head hangs crooked; my eyes do not blink.
Target acquired, initiating attack
Acquiring target, preparing to hunt
I smell living blood.

lines.zh: 这具身体还能再咬一口。
lines.en: This body has one more bite left.
You still have legs. Nice.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，不急着再死。
lines.en: I died once. No rush to again.
The bloody trail on the floor is mine.
Aiming at prey, preparing to attack
Targeting prey, initiating attack
Aiming at prey, preparing to bite
Targeting prey, preparing to gnaw
Aiming at prey, preparing to tear
Targeting prey, preparing to devour
Aiming at prey, preparing to chomp
Targeting prey, preparing to pull
Aiming at prey, preparing to chew
Targeting prey, preparing to rip

lines.zh: 我把头扭到一个奇怪角度。
lines.en: I twist my head to a strange angle.

lines.zh: 断掉的腿在后面拖着响。
lines.en: My ruined legs drag and rasp.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根挪到你侧面。
lines.en: I slide along the wall to your flank.
No need to run. I am slower than you.

lines.zh: 我的指甲已经抠进地面。
lines.en: My nails have dug into the floor.
Your boots sound too crisp.
I am counting your backward steps.
This bite will leave a tearing wound.
Sssss, bite!
Mucus喷射, entangle!
Lunge at you, rip flesh!
Tentacles tighten, can't move!
Devour you, until none left!
Wrap around you, nightmare ensues!
My hand closes around your calf.
Struggle in mucus, hard to escape!
Can't escape, devoured!
Tentacles grab you, die in pain!
I latch onto your calf and don't let go.
My nails tear your trouser leg open.
This one will make you bleed.
I lie on top of you and stay.

lines.zh: 咬掉你一块，我就有腿了。
lines.en: One piece of you, and I get legs.
My teeth are chattering. Not talking.
Decaying flesh, I emerge!
Dark corners, I arrive!
Rotten soil, I awaken!
My legs stopped obeying me long ago.
Hunger drives me, I descend!
Rotting breath, I arrive!
Corpse chunks, I appear!
Decay, I rise!
Starving, I descend!
Decaying flesh, I emerge!

lines.zh: 这堆尸块里有一块动了。
lines.en: One piece of this corpse pile moved.
I crawl out from under the rubble.
One more crawler on the street.

lines.zh: 我的腿是被撕掉的那种。
lines.en: My legs are the torn-off kind.

lines.zh: 焦皮的味道，我自己都闻得到。
lines.en: Even I can smell my own scorched skin.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来受伤了！
lines.en: Fallen and hurt!
Water is pouring into my lungs!
My back is blown open!
I crawl slow, so I get hit square.
Magic sears across my back.
Starvation hurts!
I crawl slow. Lightning doesn't.
Hurt by Void!
